comments.author: AliBayan
comments.body:
In Taiwan overall, I think Glasswork got me best contribs and exchange rates. Given enough patience, you can even produce it locally, around EA (you can gather rocks in Yuntaisha for instance - handi r6 needed to process these).

Other stuff of course good too - fragrances (Jasmine / Sandalwood), jewels (Sapphire and many other are just fine), European Armour. You can gather / make all that stuff around India, given skills and recipes.

Lately I've also been making the Western Books at the Taiwan Southeast Coast, Anping just loves them.
